news.title: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited (NSEI:SPECTRUM) agreed to acquire Alric Electric Private Limited for INR 12.5 million.
news.body:
Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited (NSEI:SPECTRUM) agreed to acquire Alric Electric Private Limited for INR 12.5 million on February 4, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 12.5 million will be paid by Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited. As part of consideration, INR 12.5 million is paid towards common equity of Alric Electric Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Alric Electric Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 574.75 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by acquirer board. The deal has been approved by the board. The deal is expected to be completed between Feb 4, 2026 and Mar 4, 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹6.44 (vs ₹5.29 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.44 (up from ₹5.29 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.27b (up 3.7% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹101.2m (up 23% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.0% (up from 6.8% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 46% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 96% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
